scenario.name: Test: Roxy-WI service (target only)
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Single-VM scenario that deploys only the Roxy-WI HAProxy web interface target (CVE-2022-31137) on Debian 12, used to exercise the roxy_wi module's secgen_test tiers 1-2 (provisioned, and Apache serving the site over HTTPS on port 443) via the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent pipeline. Tier 3 SKIPs with no attacker VM present.
